name: Star Realms

key_numbers.label: Hand drawn at end of turn

setup.text: Put the Explorer cards in their own face-up pile.
Shuffle the Trade Deck (the faction cards plus the 3 Merc Cruisers) and place it face down. Leave room beside it for the Scrap Heap.
Turn the top 5 Trade Deck cards face up to form the Trade Row.
Leave the silver-bordered Gambit cards and the oversized challenge cards in the box for a first game.
Take a Personal Deck of 8 Scouts and 2 Vipers, shuffle it and put it face down with room beside it for a discard pile.
Start on 50 Authority. Track it with the score cards, pen and paper or anything else you like.
Choose the first player at random. The first player draws a short starting hand; the others draw more.

by_count.2: First player draws 3 cards; the second player draws 5.
by_count.3: First player draws 3 cards, the next player 4, the last player 5.
by_count.4: First player draws 3 cards, the next player 4, the other two players 5 each.

turn.summary: Each turn has three phases: Main, Discard, then Draw. Play everything useful in your hand, buy cards, attack, then refill to five.
steps: Main phase, in any order and as often as you like: play cards from hand (free), use Base abilities, use Ally and Scrap abilities, spend Trade to buy, and spend Combat to attack.
Playing a ship triggers its main ability at once. Each other ability can be used once per turn.
An Ally ability is available once you have another card of the same faction in play. Order of play does not matter.
To buy, spend Trade equal to the card's cost and put it in your discard pile. Replace a bought Trade Row card straight away. Explorers can be bought too.
To attack, spend Combat from your pool: lower an opponent's Authority by any amount, or destroy a Base by spending its Defense.
Discard phase: unused Trade and Combat vanish; ships in play and any cards left in hand go to your discard pile. Bases stay in play.
Draw phase: draw 5 cards, reshuffling your discard pile into a new deck whenever your deck runs out mid-draw.

end: The game ends when only one player still has Authority above zero. In a free-for-all, a player at zero or below is out and all their cards go to the Scrap Heap.

scoring.text: There are no points. Authority is your life total and starts at 50.
Authority gain from cards is added at once and may take you above 50.
The last player left above zero Authority wins.

missed.text: If an opponent has an Outpost in play, you cannot attack them or target their other Bases until every Outpost is destroyed.
Damage to a Base that does not destroy it disappears at the end of the turn, so deal it all in one turn.
A card that says destroy target Base destroys it without spending Combat.
Buying a card does not play it. It goes to your discard pile and none of its abilities fire.
A card scrapped any way other than its own Scrap ability gives no Scrap effect. A scrapped Explorer goes back to the Explorer pile.
Ally abilities and Scrap abilities can be used in addition to a card's main ability, and the Scrap can be used before or after the other effects.
If you cannot do all of an ability, do as much as you can in the order written.

not_covered: Solo and cooperative challenge play (Nemesis Beast, Pirates of the Dark Star)
Team and variant formats: Hunter, Hunter First Blood, Hydra, Emperor and Raid
Gambit cards and their handicap rules
5 and 6 player games, which need a second set
